Sibson's α-mutual information is

I_α(X;Y) = (α/(α−1)) log ∫ (Σ_x p(x) f(y−√snr·x)^α)^{1/α} dy,

where f is the standard Gaussian density.

As snr → ∞, the Gaussian bumps centered at the different support points separate, so at each y only one term of the sum matters. The integral then becomes

Σ_x ∫ (p(x)^{1/α}) f(y−√snr·x) dy = Σ_x p(x)^{1/α}.

Hence I_α → (α/(α−1)) log Σ_x p(x)^{1/α}.

The Rényi entropy of order β is H_β = (1/(1−β)) log Σ p^β. Setting β = 1/α gives 1/(1−1/α) = α/(α−1), which matches. So β = 1/α.

Solution 1 gives β = α, Solution 2 gives 1/(1+α), and Solution 3 gives 1/(1−α). None equals 1/α, so all three are wrong.

VERDICT 1: REJECT
VERDICT 2: REJECT
VERDICT 3: REJECT
